name: Singapore
description: Singapore from Temasek and the Malay kingdoms to Raffles' port, Japanese occupation, independence and a rich city state.

checkpoints.name: Temasek
checkpoints.note: Temasek was a trading port of the Malay world, and a kingdom of Singapura was there in the 1300s. Later the island was a quiet part of the Johor sultanate.

checkpoints.name: The British port
checkpoints.note: Raffles founded a free port in 1819, and Singapore grew into a great port of Chinese, Malay and Indian traders. Japan took it in 1942.

checkpoints.name: The city state
checkpoints.note: Singapore won self-rule in 1959, joined Malaysia in 1963 and became independent in 1965. Under Lee Kuan Yew it became one of the richest places in the world.
